intro: I've supervised undergraduate and master's projects on topic models, NLP for science and innovation policy, applied machine learning, and conversational tools. If you enjoy projects that start from real questions and end in usable systems, we might be a good match.
focus: I'm especially interested in new projects on youth mental health: models and tools that help clinicians and researchers reason about trajectories of risk and protective factors. If you'd like to work on something connected to this, or to any other of my current research areas, send a short email with your background and one or two ideas you'd be excited to explore.
